decisionsTitle: Four sentences say what happens: the link's deadline from the email, the lapsed place's owner, the templates email's button, the waiting-list resend (amending §513, §639, §641)
decisionsSection:
**Why.** `docs/QUEUE.md` «Later» parked one words-only branch after the reviews of `BR-V2.60`–`BR-V2.62`: «the public refusal page says «48 h de la formular» where the deadline is from the email's departure (§513); the hold-lapsed email's subject could name the person; the templates email's button label; a manual waiting-list resend still opens with «te-am adăugat pe lista de așteptare» (§641, the resend decision's nit)». The reason is the owner's standing direction of 2026-10-02 (§637): people lose emails or find them in spam, and must always find a way through — so an email must say what it is and what happens next, and a page must not give a deadline that has moved. Four sentences told people something slightly untrue or unhelpful; each now says what happens. Nothing else changes: no state, no allocator, no message type, no migration, no dependency.

**1. The confirmation page's two refusals count the deadline from the first email (amending the words of §348 after §513).** When the places and the waiting list are full, or the event has no waiting list, `/registrations/confirm/<token>` refuses and says the same link can be opened again while it is good. It said «Linkul din email rămâne valabil {confirmation} de la trimiterea formularului». Since §513 the email link's deadline runs from the moment the first email that started it left the outbox, not from the form: a person who confirms late was told a deadline that had already moved. `Registrations.confirm.waitlistFull` and `…noWaitlist` now say «Linkul e valabil {confirmation} de când a plecat primul email» / “The link is valid for {confirmation} from when the first email left”, the same rule the resend page's `fullResend` already states («Termenul din primul tău email curge de când a plecat acela»). «Primul» because a resend mints a newer link but moves no deadline (§513: only the marked first send re-bases). Each sentence was also tightened under 200 characters (§511), a placeholder counted as one, keeping every fact: the address is not confirmed, nothing is held, how long the link works, open it again when a place frees.

**2. The lapsed place's subject names whose place it was (§638).** `DECLARATION_HOLD_EXPIRED`'s subject was «Locul tău la {event} a expirat». On an address that registers a family (§389) the one inbox receives the message for each person, and «Locul tău» did not say whose. The subject is now «Locul pentru {participantName} la {event} a expirat» / “The place for {participantName} at {event} has expired” — the person's registered name, as the cancellation's subject already names it (§547) — and keeps «Locul tău» / “Your place” when no name is known. The body is unchanged. The club's editable text for the message (§247) now offers `{participantName}` in its starting subject.

**3. The templates email's button says what it is for (§639).** «Șabloanele textelor legale s-au schimbat: regenerează și aprobă» ended on a generic «Deschide documentele legale» / “Open the legal documents”. The button opens «Versiune nouă», where «Regenerează toate» is, and the body already says «butonul de mai jos te duce acolo». It now names the screen it opens and what is done there: «Versiune nouă: regenerează textele» / “New version: regenerate the texts”, built from the screen's own name in the catalogues (`legalTemplatesWords`' `newVersion`), so the label follows the screen if it is renamed. It does not say «aprobă»: the press only regenerates, and approving is done afterwards on «Documente legale», as the body says («apasă «Aprobă ciornele» pe «Documente legale»»). The link is unchanged; the platform still approves nothing (§29, `AGENTS.md` §10.8).

**4. A waiting-list email sent again by hand does not greet the person as just added (§641).** «Retrimite emailul» on a waiting registration sends `WAITLIST_JOINED` again, which opened «{event} este complet momentan, așa că te-am adăugat pe lista de așteptare» — true at the first send, odd on a resend days later. When the outbox row is an Administrator's manual resend (`isManualResend`, already written by `queueManualResend`), the renderer sets `waitlistResent` and the opening says first that the email is sent again, then where the person stands: «Îți retrimitem emailul: ești în continuare pe lista de așteptare la {event}.» / “We are sending this again: you are still on the waiting list for {event}.” — a person who asked the club for the email they lost knows why it arrived; the promise, the standing of the moment (§629, §634) and «Nu mai pot ajunge» follow as before. The first send and the form sent again by a waiting person (§217) keep the first sentence. A club text saved for this message (§247) is the club's words and is used as written on both sends.

**Refused.** A new message type or a payload field for the resend (the row's own `isManualResend` says it); naming the person in the lapsed place's body (the four sentences only); rewording the other refusal pages, which name no deadline; showing on the confirmation page the instant the first email left — its `full` branch reads no token, and a new query for a sentence was not worth it.

**Tests.** `tests/unit/registrations/refusal-deadline-words.test.ts` (both catalogues: the email's departure, never the form, under 200 characters, the same rule as `fullResend`); `tests/unit/notifications/hold-lapsed-email.test.ts` (the named subject in both languages, «Locul tău» without a name) and `email-copy-prefill.test.ts` (the field in the starting subject); `tests/integration/notifications/hold-lapsed-email.test.ts` (the rendered subject and the club copy's); `tests/unit/legal-documents/templates-notice.test.ts` (the button names «Versiune nouă», never «aprobă», with its link); `tests/integration/registrations/resend-waiting-list.test.ts` (a manual resend opens «Îți retrimitem emailul: ești în continuare…» / “We are sending this again: you are still…” in both halves, never «te-am adăugat»), with `tests/integration/notifications/waitlist-joined-position.test.ts` holding the first send's words.
changelogLine: - **Four sentences say what happens** — the confirmation page's «full» refusals count the link's time from the first email, not the form; the lapsed-place email's subject names whose place it was; the legal-templates email's button says «Versiune nouă: regenerează textele»; a waiting-list email resent by hand opens «Îți retrimitem emailul: ești în continuare pe lista de așteptare». §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given a confirmation refused because the places and the waiting list are full, or the event has no waiting list, when the page says how long the same link stays good, then it counts the email-link window from when the first email left, never from the form, in both languages and under 200 characters (2026-10-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Criterion 66 (amended): Given a declaration hold that `expireStaleHolds` releases to somebody who wanted the place, by any path — the maintenance job, a newcomer's confirmation, a cancellation's refill, an offer or a place given by staff, a capacity raise — when the transaction commits, then exactly one `DECLARATION_HOLD_EXPIRED` is queued for that hold (key `registration:<id>:hold-lapsed:<deadline>`), in its own language, to its delivery address, with the deadline that passed in the payload; a later sweep queues nothing more, and a registration restarted into a new hold that lapses too queues a second one; a TEST registration's is queued with no club copy; its subject is «Locul pentru <persoana> la <eveniment> a expirat» / “The place for <name> at <event> has expired” («Locul tău la …» / “Your place at …” when no name is known), and it renders the deadline in the event's zone, whether the place went to the waiting list, and one of three next steps read at the send — join the waiting list, register again, or the desk on the day — with the registration page as its only button and no token; a hold released at or after the start, a cancelled event's, or a lapsed waiting-list offer queues none, and a row whose event was cancelled or started before the send, or whose registration has since left that lapsed hold (restarted, signed late, or lapsed again with a newer deadline), is withdrawn (2026-10-02, `DECISIONS.md` §638) (2026-10-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a `LEGAL_TEMPLATES_CHANGED` email, when it is rendered, then its one button names the screen it opens and what is done there — «Versiune nouă: regenerează textele» / “New version: regenerate the texts”, the screen's name read from the catalogues — never promises an approval, and leads to `/admin/legal/new` in the recipient's language (2026-10-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given an Administrator's resend of `WAITLIST_JOINED`, when it is rendered, then it opens by saying it is sent again and where the person stands — «Îți retrimitem emailul: ești în continuare pe lista de așteptare la {event}.» / “We are sending this again: you are still on the waiting list for {event}.” — and never says the person was just added; the first send keeps «te-am adăugat pe lista de așteptare» (2026-10-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: four sentences say what happens: the link's time from the first email, the lapsed place names whose, the templates email's button, the waiting-list resend
